A good haul. The stair down is still open, and deeper is richer.

actions.actionMessage: Oh no, more monsters!

items.itemDescription: Long enough to reach the floor above.
Someone carried this a long way.
Stamped with a mark nobody here can read.

actions.actionMessage: A blade springs from the floor!
A blade springs from the floor!
Something unfolds itself from the ceiling.
A loose stone gives, and something is wedged behind it.
He points back the way you came, and will not say why.
A counterweight drops behind the wall, and a bolt slides.

npcs.npcMessage: Three ways out of here and I found none of them. Mind the doors -- iron opens iron.

items.itemDescription: Cracked glass, and a wick that still catches.

Rubble settles, and the gallery opens a little further.
Nothing else is moving down here. You sit a while.
The lantern gutters, catches, and holds.

items.itemDescription: Iron filings in a twist of cloth.
Hold it and the floor forgets where you were standing.

actions.actionMessage: A blade springs from the floor!

A blade springs from the floor!
He presses something into your hand.
The blade was being watched.
The floor gives way and you land badly, somewhere else.

npcs.npcMessage: I cut these galleries. Take this -- it is no use to me now.

items.itemDescription: Grinding a blade on it leaves an edge that stays.
Long enough to reach the floor above.

He will not come with you, and will not say why not.

npcs.npcMessage: The sentinels do not sleep and do not tire. Go around them.

items.itemDescription: Driven through a scrap of prayer.
Tied by somebody who expected you back.

The shrine is yours to sit at now.
It is warm, which nothing down here should be.

items.itemDescription: Cold to hold, and blows land softer.
Notched, and worn smooth by a thumb.
It closes your wounds with somebody else's.

npcs.npcMessage: I cut that lock. I can uncut it, if you have walked far enough.

With nothing left to guard it, the bronze door gives.

items.itemDescription: Drink, and nothing looks your way.
Somebody gilded it, a long time ago.

items.itemDescription: It beats, slowly, and so do you.
Long enough to reach the floor above.
Whatever is inside has not been opened.

The tally burns out, and the shrine gives up what it kept.
The antechamber is quiet. Below it, something is not.

npcs.npcMessage: Lay my tally at the shrine below and I am done here. The thing past it does not tire, and does not miss twice.

items.itemDescription: The reason anyone comes down here.

Something vast uncoils before the vault door.
The Dungeon Lord falls. A sigil cools in your hand.
The circle takes you, and you are standing in daylight.
One of the statues along the wall is not a statue.
Nothing moves in the deep now. Only you.
